screening_visit: Your screening visit is the first appointment where the study team checks if you meet the eligibility criteria.
day_0_procedures: Day 0 is when you officially start the study and receive your first study-related procedures or medication.
visit_duration: Visit length varies by procedure, but most visits last between 30 minutes and 2 hours.
alcohol_policy: Alcohol use may be restricted during the study. Please follow the instructions given by the study team.
supplement_use: Some supplements are not allowed. Always check with the study team before taking any vitamins or herbal products.
pain_medication: Certain pain medications like ibuprofen may be restricted. Ask the study team before taking any medication.
side_effects_info: Side effects vary by study. The team will explain all known risks during the consent process.
report_side_effects: If you feel unwell or notice side effects, contact the study team immediately.
withdrawal_rights: You can leave the study at any time without penalty or impact on your regular medical care.
payment_compensation: Participants may receive reimbursement for time and travel according to the study protocol.
payment_timeline: Compensation is usually provided after completed visits based on the study schedule.
travel_support: Some studies offer travel or meal support. Ask your site coordinator for details.
data_privacy: Your personal and medical data are kept confidential and protected by law.
data_access: Only authorized study staff and regulators can review your study data.
medication_rules: Some medications are prohibited during the study. Always inform the team about what you take.
randomization: Randomization means participants are assigned to treatment groups by chance.
blinded_study: In a blinded study, you may not know which treatment you are receiving.
unblinding: Unblinding only happens if it is medically necessary for your safety.
lab_tests: Blood tests, ECGs, or imaging may be required depending on the study protocol.
fasting_rules: Some lab tests require fasting. The study team will tell you if this applies to you.
missed_dose: If you miss a dose, do not double up. Contact the study team for instructions.
drug_storage: Study medication must be stored as instructed, often at room temperature and away from light.
return_medication: You must return unused study medication at each visit.
safety_oversight: Your safety is monitored by the investigator and sometimes an independent safety committee.
ethics_approval: The study has been reviewed and approved by an ethics committee before starting.
protocol_changes: Any changes to the study must be approved and explained to you.
reconsent: If important new information arises, you may be asked to sign an updated consent form.
monitoring_visits: Monitors regularly review the study to ensure rules are followed.
audit_readiness: Study records must always be available for inspection by authorities.
results_publication: Study results may be published once the trial is completed.
results_access: You can ask the study team if and when results will be shared with participants.
emergency_contact: You will receive emergency contact information for the study doctor or coordinator.
closeout: Close-out happens after the last participant finishes and all data are finalized.
data_archiving: Study records are stored securely for the required retention period.
compliance_tracking: The study team tracks visits, dosing, and procedures to ensure accuracy.
training_requirements: All staff complete Good Clinical Practice training before working on the study.
insurance_coverage: Some studies include insurance for study-related injury. Ask your site for details.
budget_control: Study finances are tracked and reviewed by the sponsor.
vendor_management: External vendors must be qualified and monitored by the sponsor.
risk_management: Risks are continuously reviewed and mitigated throughout the study.
